comparison.objective: Trace crossing coolant lines to identify and close only the leaking branch valve; candidate finishes four installed HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual/topological pipe tracing and contact-driven valve-lever rotation versus coaxial mandrel alignment, bimanual hammer impact, fracture-force control, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Stop spray at the correct valve without trial-closing other valves or starving the running branch versus four valid fractures, all fragments physically contained, no damage, tools released, and stable completion.
comparison.reason: Both use real rigid-body contact and penalize unsafe shortcuts, but line-tracing plus valve selection is materially different from impact-mediated insert finishing. No spec versions or exact valve-angle threshold are provided.
